name: db2-az7-generator
description: Generador DDL y DML de pruebas para DB2 AZ7 desde Excel

scripts.build:docker: npm run generate && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t db2-az7:latest .
scripts.up: docker rm -f db2-az7 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name db2-az7 --hostname db2server --platform linux/amd64 --privileged=true -p ${DB2_HOST_PORT:-50000}:${DB2_CONTAINER_PORT:-50000} -e LICENSE=accept -e DBNAME=${DB2_NAME:-AZ7DB} -e DB2INSTANCE=db2inst1 -e DB2INST1_PASSWORD=${DB2_PASSWORD:-db2admin} -e TO_CREATE_SAMPLEDB=false -e PERSISTENT_HOME=false db2-az7:latest
